scientific_integrity: The proof separates the symbolic residue classification from a finite exact prime-product certificate. All proof-critical product comparisons use integer cross-multiplication; floating-point values are descriptive only.
scientific_limitations: This is a necessary lower bound, not a proof of Deaconescu's conjecture. The value 2859 is the exact cutoff of the stated modulo-3 extremal-product argument, but stronger congruence information may force a larger bound.
title: Deaconescu numbers require at least 2859 distinct prime factors
